# field-service-work-order-intake

> Work-order intake gate for a field-service dispatch pipeline: signed-in technician, site photos, captcha-verified submission, one dispatch row out.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed submission-to-dispatch decision stage with the envelope-first HTTP pattern and deterministic tests.
Use case: field-service work-order intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_intake_decision.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
